channel.title: Obsidian — The Journal
channel.description: Reflections on fatherhood, faith, war, and the long road home.

item.title: Outnumbered
item.description: I thought I might raise a son. Instead, three daughters helped raise a different version of me.

item.title: A Different Kind of Strength
item.description: Sometimes the strongest thing a father can do is soften.

item.title: The Man Behind the Father
item.description: Sometimes we get so focused on being what everyone needs that we forget there's still a person underneath it all.

item.title: They're Watching
item.description: Our children will hear what we say, but they'll learn from how we live.

item.title: Leave Room for the Silence
item.description: Sometimes being there means knowing when not to speak.

item.title: Stand Firm
item.description: The world will try to shape them. Our job is to shape them first.

item.title: The Trail Always Teaches
item.description: Some lessons can't be taught. They have to be lived.

item.title: Presence Over Perfection
item.description: Fatherhood isn't about getting everything right. It's about refusing to stop showing up.
